event_threshold_origin: Frozen v1 training 75th percentile; unchanged for comparison
calibration: 2025 sigmoid calibration with purged outcomes, C=1; skip when fewer than 10 examples in either class
alert_threshold: maximize F2 on 2025 subject to precision >= 0.35 and false-positive rate <= 0.25; fixed grid 0.05 to 0.85; otherwise 0.5
scope: 2020-2025 are consumed development data. 2026 is new retrospective holdout, not a prospective trial. No performance guarantee.
